output.text:
Done. `meetings-07-advanced.p01.verdicts.jsonl` has 150 lines, one per CSV row, in the CSV's order: 127 L8, 12 L1, 11 L3. Every rejection carries a `sop` with real newlines escaped as `\n`, and I checked programmatically that each corrected circuit accounts for every word of its message.

What drove the rejections:

| Kind | Rows | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L1 | 39, 60, 62, 99, 150, 260, 278, 285, 291, 297, 314, 317 | form of a clause wrong (statement as `interrogative`, reported question as `interrogative`), a noun made the verb ("Family", "meeting", "Hiring"), a command held as a fragment ("colour it gold", "block 3 hours"), main verb demoted to auxiliary ("Hannah needs adding") |
| L3 | 22, 47, 57, 72, 109, 113, 163, 186, 202, 308, 311 | relation with the wrong end ("so" landing on a nominal instead of the clause), a clause left hanging untied, a coordination joining across a clause that belongs to no conjunct, a linking word held as nominal head ("of"), the name/object merged into one nominal, note content turned into a separate command |

Judgment calls worth flagging, since they are where a second judge could differ: I accepted a `nonfinite`/`declarative` label swap when the clause has no subject of its own (rows 227, 233, 250, 306), but rejected it when the message's own statement is labelled a nonfinite clause and its command verb disappears. I also accepted note/agenda content held as a clause coordinated with the clause that mentions the note (300, 301, 305, 309, 313), rejecting it only where the content was made a separate command that the message does not give (311) or where the tie ran to the wrong clause (186).

One environment note: another process wrote to this same path while I worked — placeholder `{"grade": "L8", "note": ""}` lines and a few foreign verdicts appeared and replaced my earlier appends twice. I rebuilt the file from my own verdicts and verified it afterwards; if that other writer runs again it may mix lines back in, so the set can be re-checked with the `n` values against the CSV. No other file was created or modified.
